title: Vintage Kodak Instamatic X-15F 126 Film Camera - Untested
descriptionText: The product is a vintage Kodak Instamatic X-15F camera that uses 126 film format. This point-and-shoot camera from the United States features multicolor capabilities, allowing users to capture images in a unique and retro style. The camera is designed for easy use and is ideal for film photography enthusiasts looking to explore the nostalgia of analog photography.
